method: Each violation's bbox is intersected (5nm margin) against the klayout.db.Region formed by merging all layer (64,20) nwell.drawing shapes recursively flattened from layout/modexp.gds (matches klt drc's own _run_check(), which calls .merged() before dispatching to Region.space_check/width_check). nwell.space.1 violations touching exactly one merged polygon are a same-polygon concave notch (space_check, unlike the source rule's isolated semantics, flags these) -> check_engine_limitation. nwell.space.1 violations touching two or more distinct merged polygons are a genuine sub-1.27um gap between two separate nwell wells, traced (via layout/modexp.def cell-instance placement cross-reference) to non-abutting standard-cell instances -> accepted_documented_gap (layout/README.md's 'no filler-cell insertion' limitation). Every nwell.width.1 violation also touches exactly one merged, non-box polygon at a locally narrow waist formed by misaligned adjacent cells' nwell rectangles (confirmed: every one of the 718 raw per-instance nwell rectangles is >=1.76um wide/1.605um tall, so no individual library-cell nwell shape is itself sub-threshold) -> accepted_documented_gap.
